fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing company with exceptional revenue and earnings expansion, strong margins, and a healthy balance sheet, albeit with very high valuation multiples.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 13.5%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY and earnings growth 144.4% YoY indicate strong business expansion.
Quarterly earnings growth of 152.4% shows accelerating profitability.
Gross margin of 76.0% and profit margin of 26.7% demonstrate excellent pricing power and efficiency.
Return on equity at 21.1% signifies effective use of shareholder capital.
Current ratio of 11.30 and quick ratio of 10.55 indicate strong short-term liquidity.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 232.44 and forward P/E of 82.33 suggest a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 59.28 also indicates a premium valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 2.80, while offset by strong liquidity, warrants monitoring.
Beta of 3.96 indicates significantly higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs has experienced significant upward price momentum, with articles highlighting a 203% surge in three months and a 70% rise since its last earnings report. The company's strong revenue and earnings growth, coupled with impressive margins, are driving this performance. While the stock has seen substantial gains, analysts maintain a consensus 'buy' rating, suggesting continued optimism despite the high valuation multiples.
